create_period_array: create a PeriodArray from a sequence of Period scalars or datetime-like strings
build_period_range: build a PeriodArray range from start, end, or periods parameters with a given frequency
convert_period_to_timestamp: convert a PeriodArray to a DatetimeArray by casting to timestamps
convert_period_frequency: convert a PeriodArray to a different frequency using asfreq with start or end alignment
extract_period_fields: extract year, month, day, hour, minute, second, quarter, and other time fields from a PeriodArray
